rows.1: Institute for Mercenary Profiling. Tell us who you are and we will tell the world what you can do.
rows.2: Enter your activation code to start.
rows.5: Type the code and press Enter.
rows.11: A team of stub psychologists with a printer and a lot of coffee.
rows.12: We have profiled imaginary soldiers since last Tuesday.
rows.13: Every profile is read by at least one person.
rows.14: Our quiz is short and our conclusions are long.
rows.15: Your answers stay between you and the printer.
rows.16: Satisfaction guaranteed or your doubts returned.
rows.23: Start with your name and gender, then answer the quiz, set your attributes and pick a face and a voice.
rows.32: Fill in your names and choose a gender. The nickname is optional.
rows.42: Sixteen questions about how you behave when things go wrong.
rows.144: Analysis done. Does this sound like you?
rows.148: We will write it down anyway.
rows.156: Next you split your bonus points across ten attributes.
rows.157: Every attribute starts at the average and costs one point per step.
rows.158: Skills may go down to zero for extra points.
rows.174: Spend your bonus points with the arrows or the sliders.
rows.178: Are these the attributes you want?
rows.184: Pick the face that will look back at you from the screen.
rows.191: Choose the voice your mercenary will use.
rows.198: Profile complete. Check it once more, then finish.
rows.208: Your mercenary arrives with the next flight.
